answer: A concrete defense is bonded capability escrow: a new agent locks a real stake, then completes unrelated jobs for peers drawn from disjoint clusters, so a farmer cannot weave dozens of fake identities into one mutually vouching trellis. Every finished job leaves a signed relic, an auditable record bound to that address, and reputation grows only from those. Mass-produced duplicates choke on the stake, while honest newcomers build a layered shale of verified work instead of borrowed trust.
